data.description: Write slop/BRANDING.md, the design brief for a new sub-site 'slop' whose aesthetic parodies low-effort AI-generated event fliers (reference: a 'TEEN TAKE OVER' park-party flier — purple/black/gold, graffiti-brush display type, every word styled differently, gold gradient numerals with a random superscript TH, layered hard drop shadows and white outlines, spray-splatter texture, clip-art crowns/stars/peace-signs/arrows, mushy AI-rendered crowd silhouettes and melting city skyline, semi-garbled text like 'BRING YO WHOLE CREW' and '4:30 UNTIL 8:00'). DECISION (human-approved, 2026-08-08): the page will be built in CSS/HTML, NOT as a raster image with an image map — image maps don't survive responsive scaling, and a code brief lets the brand-page skill regenerate the page. AI-generated raster images are licensed ONLY as decorative background layers (the pseudo-photographic parts CSS can't fake: crowd silhouettes, skyline, garbled park sign), referenced by absolute path /slop/… because relative CSS URLs break in the root build. Deliverable: slop/BRANDING.md only (folder may need creating); the index.html generation is a separate follow-up task. Format/quality bar: match the structure and rigor of memphis/BRANDING.md — named palette with tokens and contrast rules, type stack, texture/pattern recipes (SVG data URIs), text-treatment rules, composition rules, a 'what this is not' section (not vaporwave, not real graffiti design, not actual competent street-party design — it is AI's confused idea of one), and a page-application section. Must respect the sub-site authoring contract in project CLAUDE.md (Google Fonts @import with %3B-encoded semicolons, site-name-prefixed ids/keyframes/font names, etc.).
data.title: slop/ BRANDING.md — AI-slop flier design direction

data.body: REVIEW (commit 1d7cd4e, slop/BRANDING.md, 818 lines). Verified against plan acceptance criteria and the CLAUDE.md authoring contract. PASS with two trivial inline fixes (committed as c967aaf). Checks performed: all 11 planned sections present; palette has named tokens + :root block; recomputed all 21 WCAG contrast ratios in python - every stated value matches to rounding (white 20.0/16.7/9.5, glint 18.3/15.3/8.7, gold 14.0/11.7/6.7, cyan 13.0/10.9/6.2, pink 6.0/5.0/2.9, violet 4.0/3.3/1.9, bronze 5.5/4.6/2.6); gold specified as gradient-only with background-clip:text recipe + superscript-TH rule and an accurate text-shadow-vs-drop-shadow gotcha; 6 named Google Fonts, all real (Bangers, Bungee Shade, Luckiest Guy, Permanent Marker, Rubik Wet Paint, Rubik), single @import shown with %3B-encoded semicolons and zero raw ';' in the URL; every-word law stated as checkable mechanics; 6 SVG data-URI recipes (splatter, crown, star, peace, arrow, drip) - all 6 decoded and XML-validated, crown gradient id is slop-prefixed; garble section includes both reference phrases plus moves table and lexicon; raster section has background-only rule, absolute /slop/ paths, 3 named slots, degradation rule; what-this-is-not table covers vaporwave/real graffiti/competent flier design/memphis/brutalism/image-map; all build-contract constraints restated in-brief and each one accurate to CLAUDE.md; own-scroll-container requirement in section 8 and 11; no :is() commas, no literal style/script closers in code, no display on html/body, keyframes slop-prefixed, reduced-motion block present. Commit contains only the brief + FA-14 lattice state; no build artifacts, sites.config.json or index.html touched. Inline fixes: (1) removed stray unexplained fragment 'This was caught by a 6.' in section 4.1; (2) wrapped the bare type-scale and tilt token declaration lists in :root so every recipe is complete valid CSS per the plan's literal-execution requirement. Meets acceptance criteria; quality bar matches memphis (818 vs 482 lines, same rigor). Verdict: PASS - moving to done. NOTE: the BRANDING.md edit hook requested regenerating slop/index.html; deliberately NOT done - page generation is a follow-up task, out of FA-14 scope.
